pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with predominantly rounded vertices. Edge transitions from dark brown to light interstitial space show soft gradients. Patch size is non-uniform, with larger spatial footprints in the central flank decreasing toward the dorsal line.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored corridors separating patches. Junctions are predominantly tri-radial. Pathway width is variable, appearing wider in the central flank region and constricting as the network approaches the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude sawtooth profile along the upper neck and withers, characterized by high-frequency pixel variations against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct, parallel, light-colored linear marks are visible on the mid-left flank, extending diagonally across several dark patches.
